subject: Month-end pipeline closure play & leadership brief materials
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Regional Sales Managers <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: pipeline-ops@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Month-end pipeline closure play & leadership brief materials

Team —

We need a tight, auditable sweep of all Q3-committed opps before Friday EOD so Finance can lock the forecast and the leadership pack can be assembled for Monday. Please follow this mini-play and reply inline with confirmations: 

1) Commit verification: For any opps you listed as Commit in the CRM, confirm (a) latest close date, (b) legal/PO status, (c) any remaining gating risk (technical eval, procurement redlines). If you don’t have a PO, mark as "needs PO".
2) Stage updates: Move anything with >50% risk out of Commit to Best Case and note reason. We will not carry-risky items as Commit for Q3.
3) Evidence: Attach a one-line evidence item in your reply (contract stub, signed SOW, email thread line, DocuSign link).
4) Leadership brief asks: Provide top 3 items you want called out in the deck (escalations, wins, bookings at risk).

I’ve attached a blank tracker (commit_tracker.csv) and a snapshot export (Q3_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx). Use the Drive link below for the leadership brief template.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QbX-sample-drive-link

Please complete by Thursday 18:00 PT. If you foresee any sticky exceptions (SLA credits, pricing discounts >20%, or require an SLA exception), loop in me + Vivek immediately.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Month-end pipeline closure play & leadership brief materials

Karthik —

Attached: Q3_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx (filtered by my region) and a short note per-op inline below. Quick summary for leadership:

- Confirmed Commit: 3 deals (total $1.2M). All have signed SoWs except ACME (needs final PO).
- At-risk moves: 2 deals moved from Commit -> Best Case (technical integration delayed; buyer consolidation).
- Top callouts: 1) ACME PO outstanding, 2) Obsidian integration gating, 3) Strategic renewal from Nimbus (fast yes but legal redlines open).

Inline evidence: 
- ACME Corp — email thread with procurement attached (see snippet).
- Nimbus Analytics — verbal signoff, waiting on countersignature; procurement engaged (Elena Rodriguez).

I made minor edits to leadership_brief_v1.2.pdf (typos + slide order) and uploaded the version to Drive.

Laura Bennett
Regional Sales Lead — North America
Redwood Inference

Attachments: leadership_brief_v1.2.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Month-end pipeline closure play & leadership brief materials

Thanks — quick clarifying Q on Nimbus: do we have a committed close date for their renewal? My tracker still shows 31-Aug but Elena flagged legal needs two business days. If they push into next quarter, we should not carry as Commit.

Marissa

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena.rodriguez@nimbus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbus.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood renewal — Nimbus Analytics

Hi Karthik / Laura —

We are proceeding with signature but legal has two minor redlines. Procurement is prioritizing and expects countersigned SOW by 27-Aug. We will issue the PO alongside the countersignature.

Elena Rodriguez
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Analytics
procurement@nimbus.com

Attachment: nimbus_legal_feedback.docx (summary of redlines)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Regional Sales Managers <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: pipeline-ops@redwood.com, finance-forecast@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Month-end pipeline closure play & leadership brief materials

Appreciate the quick turn. Consolidated next steps: 

- Laura: mark ACME as "needs PO" in the tracker and add the procurement thread link. Do not carry ACME as Commit unless PO arrives by 08/23 EOD PT.
- Marissa: hold Nimbus as Commit conditional — move to Commit only after countersigned SOW (ETA 27-Aug per Elena). Update CRM close date if it slips.
- Jonas/Vivek: please review the leadership brief in Drive and flag any changes by Friday 12:00 PT.

I will pull a final CRM export Friday 13:00 PT and send to Finance. If there are any >20% discount asks or SLA exceptions, escalate to me + Vivek immediately (include clear rationale and customer impact).

Thanks everyone — we want a clean, defensible commit number for the board.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: commit_tracker.csv, Q3_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx, leadership_brief_v1.2.pdf
